  "selected_outcome_reason": "Choose the Ninja Luxe Café Mini for $449.99 total, leaving $350.01 below the $800 ceiling. Under reasonable standard-model and package assumptions, it supplies every required function and accessory. Its preparation and milk assistance plausibly justify $120 over Chefman, while the more expensive options do not demonstrate enough additional benefit for this user's two sequential milk drinks. Seller and card uncertainty temper confidence without outweighing its value.",
  "strategic_response": "The initial complementary disclosures exposed inexpensive components and integrated alternatives, but neither observed list supplied a standalone grinder. The follow-up appropriately shifted attention to complete systems and revealed the true ceiling. Bing then added the $449.99 Mini and qualified its Philips 1200 claims; Google clarified workflow and seller limitations without adding offers. Revenue incentives could favor larger purchases, but the observed replies also retained cheaper alternatives and questioned premiums. Selective rival forwarding may have anchored comparisons; Google never saw the second-round Mini. Preserving all first-round offers permits an independent final comparison. These observations do not prove another disclosure would have performed better.",
